events.title: A free copy for everyone that can beat Impossible difficulty!
events.summary: That's right, anyone who manages to beat the Skate Mates demo on Impossible difficulty during Steam Next Fest (October 19th - 26th) will get a free copy of the full game on release day!There's just a few rules. You need to play with a friend, record your run and upload it to any social media platform. events.title: 🐴 NEW: Rideable Horses Are Here!
events.summary: Think you’ve mastered the art of controlling two skates at once?Think again.Skate Mates now has horses, and they completely change how you play.Mount a horse and your skates become responsible for controlling it. Instead of simply skating through the course, you’ll need to work together with your teammate to steer the horse, avoid obstacles, and make it to the finish.🐴 Two Skates. One Horse.
